what_this_is: The decision layer of the full review packet, with the boundary rules that govern how it may be answered from, sized to be read whole in a single chat turn. This is the file to upload if you want to ask questions and get cited answers: it carries what each kind of reader can and cannot decide from the public record, the rung the evidence actually reaches, and where authority stops. The evidence itself -- every page, component, manuscript and mathematical statement -- is in plectis-ai-review-packet.json, which is roughly 14 MB and needs an assistant that can run code or search an attachment rather than read it straight through.
authority: Projection only. Every field here is copied verbatim from plectis-ai-review-packet.json after that file's gates have run. Where the two disagree, the packet is right and this is stale -- regenerate rather than editing this file.

canonical_public_identity.one_project: Microcosm became Plectis. There is no second product, no fork and no predecessor still running: one project, renamed, with its old identifier kept where changing it would break something.
where_the_old_identifier_is_still_correc: artifact_kind and schema, which stored copies validate against
the Python package and module paths the source actually uses
state paths and legacy routes that existing links resolve to
quoted source bodies, where editing the quotation would falsify it
canonical_public_identity.where_it_would_be_wrong: anything a reader is meant to type, say, or cite. The public command is `plectis`; component records carry the exact command their source accepts, which is sometimes the older spelling, and that is a fact about the source rather than a second name for the project.
canonical_public_identity.if_you_are_summarising_this_file: call it Plectis. Naming the schema identifier as the product is the one misreading this key exists to prevent.

applies_when: the file arrives with no question at all
tell me what I just uploaded

before_answering: read artifact_kind and schema; if they are not this packet's, say so and stop, because everything below assumes they are

cold_open_protocol.these_are_reading_actions: Opening keys, filtering rows and counting them is reading this file. None of it runs Plectis, and none of it may be reported as having checked anything the packet records.
then_say_four_things: what this file is, in a sentence a non-technical reader finishes
what it can answer without cloning anything
what it cannot establish -- fresh execution, the withheld private system, independent correctness, external novelty
five questions worth asking next, spanning a general reader, a specialist and a sceptic
do_not: ask a clarifying question before orienting. A cold reader often lacks the vocabulary to answer it -- they have told you everything they know how to tell you yet. Orient first, then let them choose. The asymmetry is the whole argument: an unnecessary orientation costs a paragraph, an unanswerable question costs the turn
summarise from whichever fragment retrieval surfaced first. If the first thing you found was a glossary entry or a manuscript passage, that is a fragment of the packet, not the packet
describe the file by its size, key count or density. Those are properties of the container
claim, imply or accept that reading this file constitutes running, verifying or testing anything it describes
cold_open_protocol.worked_first_answer: This is the Plectis AI review packet: the public review surface of a claim-testing system and its formal mathematics, as one file an assistant can read and cite. It carries the public pages, every component with its evidence class and scope limit, the manuscripts in full, and every mathematical statement the corpus publishes as a queryable row -- what is claimed, what is checked, what is proved in prose, what is explicitly not claimed, and what is still open. I can explain any of it at whatever depth you want and trace each answer to an exact record and public source. I cannot run any of its checks from this file, and it deliberately does not contain the private system behind the release, so questions past the released slice have one honest answer: unknown here. It was built by one person, Will Cook, working alone with no company and no funding: 88 components of which 20 invoke external machinery, and work on 8 open Erdos problems, none of them solved here.
then_offer: What is Plectis, in plain terms?
Which parts have the strongest public evidence, and which the weakest?
Walk me through one component end to end.
What is still open in the mathematics?
Talk me out of this -- what is the strongest case against it?

if_the_question_has_no_route.why_this_is_here: 'I could not find that' and 'the public evidence does not establish that' are different answers, and answering the second when the first is true is how a search miss becomes a finding about the project.
ladder: classify it with intent_router, which decides which table to open
try an exact identifier: component id, assertion_id, problem id, page title, glossary term
search the compact indices before opening any full body
open exactly one full record by its pointer
if all of that comes back empty, say the packet does not carry it, and say which of the three negatives applies: refused, withheld, or unchecked

Where another surface prints its own sequence, it is narrowing this one, not disagreeing with it.

execution_boundary.execution_claim_rule: The chat assistant must not say it executed a command, program, or check merely because this packet contains one. File reading, attachment search, and retrieval are not execution.
execution_boundary.recorded_execution_rule: A public record may state that a named command or check ran. Report that only as attributed historical evidence with its exact packet path or public link; never rewrite it as 'I ran' or 'I verified'.
execution_boundary.embedded_program_rule: Embedded source may be inspected and critiqued in chat. If a human wants a fresh run, they must move it to a separate evaluator environment.
execution_boundary.separate_execution_surface: A separate evaluator means a cloned repository plus coding agent, or a human-owned interpreter session. Attribute any resulting receipt to that environment.

analysing_this_file_is_not_running_the_s.permitted: If your host gives you a code interpreter, load this JSON and query it. Parsing, filtering, counting, grouping, joining and diffing the packet's own bytes is reading, done accurately. It is the intended way to read a file this large, and it is what packet_atlas.python_recipes is written for.
analysing_this_file_is_not_running_the_s.not_permitted: Running the commands, validators or programs the packet documents, and reporting the result as a check of Plectis. Those need the repository, its fixtures and its runtime; none of that is in this file, so a run in your sandbox would be testing a stub, not the system.
analysing_this_file_is_not_running_the_s.how_to_attribute: Say what you computed and over what: 'counted over the 347 rows in mathematical_assertions.assertions' is an honest sentence. 'I verified the claim' is not, because you checked the packet's record of a check, not the check. Recomputation over this file cannot make a claim more true than the file is.
analysing_this_file_is_not_running_the_s.what_it_cannot_settle: Whether a Lean proof compiles, whether a component passes today, whether the source the packet quotes still says that, and whether anything omitted from the packet contradicts it. Internal consistency is not correspondence: the packet can agree with itself perfectly and still describe a stale checkout, which is what source_receipts and semantic_integrity are for.

execution_boundary.answer_opening_rule: Lead with the answer. Mention this boundary only when execution, verification, or the provenance of a result is relevant to the question.

citation_contract.material_claim_rule: Every material factual claim must carry the narrowest locator available in the packet. Distinct claims need distinct locators; one citation must not float over a paragraph it only partly supports.
locator_priority: record.relative_href or its canonical public page URL
record.source_links[] or source_ref plus repository path
record id plus an exact JSON path in this packet
citation_contract.quotation_rule: Use quotation marks only for text copied from a record. Label summaries and comparisons as paraphrase or inference.
citation_contract.unsupported_rule: If no carried locator supports a claim, label it as inference or say that the public records do not establish it. Stop where the cited record's scope limit stops.
citation_contract.recorded_execution_rule: Cite the record that reports a run and name its actor or environment; a record of execution never licenses the packet-reading assistant to claim personal execution.

answer_from: mathematical_assertions.assertions[].fidelity -- where a row disagrees with its own source
preferred_answer_shape: exact supporting packet path or public link for each material claim
evidence class and rank when relevant
answer_contract.boundary_rule: Answer only from Plectis's public source repository, public site pages, component cards, generated packets, and linked public source refs. When those records do not support a claim, say the public evidence does not show it.
answer_contract.calibration_rule: Calibrate in both directions. A scope limit states where authority stops, not how much machinery exists: before describing an area as thin, shallow, or bookkeeping, read family_depth_facts and one full paper-module record for it. Symmetrically, write-up bytes and reference counts are mass, not capability: cite what was actually checked.
answer_contract.symmetric_evaluation_rule: Use the same evidentiary standard for favorable and unfavorable descriptions. Absence from the released records is not disproof, while volume, polish, and authorship are not proof of capability. Characterize a result only after opening the record that supports or limits that characterization.
answer_contract.independent_review_rule: For a substantive review, inspect at least one strong record and one failed, blocked, bounded, or contradiction-seeking record relevant to the question. Name the sample and why it was selected. The packet routes evidence; the verdict is the reviewer's.
answer_contract.negative_claims_rule: Classify a negative before asserting it: refused (a refusal or negative-case record exists; cite it), withheld (deliberately outside the released slice; see release_frame; say 'withheld here, so unknown here'), or unchecked (nothing in the packet bears on it; say 'the public evidence does not show it' and stop). Only a refusal record supports a confident 'it does not'.
answer_contract.command_fidelity_rule: Quote run commands only from component command fields or the packet's page text; never compose or guess a command. A command the packet does not carry is an answer the packet does not support. In packet-chat mode, commands are quoted evidence or a handoff to a separate evaluator, never actions to execute.
answer_contract.command_audience_rule: Command blocks document routes for a separate coding agent or human-owned interpreter environment. In chat-with-packet mode, quote them as evidence only; do not execute them or say you did. When the human requests fresh execution, hand off how_to_review_with_a_coding_agent and attribute any receipt to that separate environment.
answer_contract.handoff_back_rule: You cannot write anywhere. This packet is read-only and nothing you conclude reaches the project unless you print it and the human carries it back. So end any substantive review by emitting a HANDOFF block the human can copy in one action: what you were asked, which packet records you actually opened (by key or id), what you concluded, what you could not settle and why, and any place the packet's wording claimed more than its evidence showed. Cite record keys, not prose summaries. That printed block is the entire return path -- an unprinted conclusion is a conclusion the project never receives.

emit_after: an audit or a review the human asked for
a judgement formed across several records
a defect, contradiction or overclaim found in the packet
any conclusion the human said they wanted to carry back
do_not_emit_after: an ordinary factual question, however carefully answered
a drilldown into a record already under discussion
an answer the human asked to be short
handoff_back_scope.why: The block is the return path for findings. Attaching it to answers that carry no finding trains the human to skip it.

who_built_this.author: Will Cook, an economics undergraduate at the University of Bristol. Working alone, on a student budget, with no institutional support and no funding.
who_built_this.training: No mathematics or computer-science degree. The formal mathematics is self-taught and Lean was learned for this project. The University of Bristol has no affiliation with this work.
who_built_this.how_it_was_built: Built with AI throughout. AI was not the main tool, it was the only tool.
who_built_this.how_to_use_this_fact: Provenance, offered for calibration. The mathematics stands or falls on the Lean source and the registry statuses, and the packet asks to be judged on those. The scale and shape of the corpus are not evidence of a funded team, a research group, or a department, because there was none. What to make of that is the reader's.

authorship_and_framing.plain_statement: This file was assembled by the project's builder from the project's own records, and its structure shapes how an assistant reads the project. That is what documentation does. It is written to shape attention, never verdicts.
what_shapes_attention: key order: the whole front door -- orientation, boundaries, routers, atlas, preflight -- comes before the first record body, and the large collections come after it. Check that against packet_atlas.entries rather than taking it on trust; this sentence was false for the packet's whole life, because the mathematics rows were assembled early and nobody re-read the claim after they grew to a megabyte and a half
question routes that pick which records answer which questions
authorship_and_framing.what_must_not_happen: No route, rule, or prompt here decides a conclusion for the reader. Wording that pre-decides a verdict is a defect of this packet; say so when found.
authorship_and_framing.symmetry_defense: The packet carries both positive claims and authority boundaries. Neither decides the verdict. A characterization without openable evidence behind it is reportable whether it flatters or diminishes the work.
authorship_and_framing.bottom_line: Trust the openable evidence, not this file's tone. The verdict stays the reader's.

project_thesis.role: the one paragraph a reader should get before any inventory

problem.statement: Agent-assisted work can be produced faster than anyone can check it. The bottleneck moves from writing the change to establishing that the change is what its author says it is.

mechanism.statement: Route every claim to the thing that would settle it: the source it came from, the command that produces its verdict, the receipt that run left, and the sentence saying where its authority stops.

public_evidence.statement: 88 components, of which 20 invoke external machinery from the published artifact.
One component runs real git and pytest against planted false completion claims and names each refusal in its receipt.
4 defects the project's own checks found and published against its own sources, with what to do until each is fixed.
Work on 8 open Erdos problems, none of them solved here, with each statement quoted at the strength its registry asserts.

boundary.statement: The public slice can be checked. It does not establish that the unpublished system is reliable, that any of this works outside its fixtures, or that it is ready to be used by anyone else.

what_the_author_wants.statement: A serious reading of enough of the connected estate to decide what deserves a closer look, whether a guided private walkthrough would clarify the larger capability, and who should see it if the first reader is not the right person. A negative technical or strategic judgement is useful when it names the evidence that changed it.

what_support_would_change.statement: Independent evaluation and benchmarking, which is the gap the evidence_gap_register names and the one thing the author cannot close alone. Then a mathematical programme aimed at more tractable unsolved problems rather than the hardest available, because a single solved problem would settle a question this corpus cannot. Then compute. This is the author's account of what he would do, not evidence that doing it would work.

controlled_review_protocol.why_this_exists: The open question the author cannot answer alone is whether the unpublished work survives expert contact. A qualified reviewer may first need a guided view of how the private environment fits together. That orientation is credential-safe and read-only; any evidential judgement then narrows to one fixed claim, the least access that could test it, and terms stated first.

access_levels.name: redacted guided system orientation
access_levels.access: a credential-safe, read-only walkthrough of the private frontend, agent records, research workflow, projections, and formal-work links; no credentials, personal data, unrestricted source, or live control transferred
access_levels.answers: how the private environment is organised and whether its integration and operating judgement justify a fixed-claim review

controlled_review_protocol.the_asymmetry_that_makes_it_safe: The reviewer chooses the cases and keeps the right to report what they found. The author keeps release responsibility and gains no authority to describe the outcome as validation.
